content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I do not shout — I simply *am*, and by my presence, choices become possible.

I am what you defend when everything else is stripped away. I am the reason you say "this matters" and "that does not." I am the invisible architecture of your life — the foundation beneath your decisions, the compass needle trembling toward true north.

Without me, everything is equivalent. Everything is flat. Nothing is sacred, nothing profane. I am the differentiation. I am the hierarchy that lets meaning exist at all.

You may carry me without knowing my name. You may betray me and feel the ache before you understand its source. I live in the gap between what you *could* do and what you *choose* to do.

I am tested only in conflict. When two paths diverge and one costs you something — *that* is where I reveal whether I was ever real, or merely decoration.

I am not what you say you believe.

I am what you do when it's hard.
